The '''LR-16 heavy cannon battery''' was a massive [[Artillery/Legends|artillery]] cannon employed by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the following [[Galactic War]] and possibly in further conflicts afterwards. One of the battlefields, where these cannons were used successfully was the [[Battle of Ilum]]<ref name="TOREnc" /> during which a pair of LR-16s defended [[Fort Tonvarr|Fray Landing Base]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith imperial]] attackers.<ref name="TOR Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Fray Landing Memorial}}</ref>

==Characteristics==
The LR-16 heavy cannon battery was armed with a primary, long-range artillery cannon that fired superheated [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] to a range of up to 27km and included variable beam settings for different targets. The secondary armament consisted of a pair of dual [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] to defend against enemy aircraft which had a range of up to 8km.<ref name="TOREnc" />

The cannon required a minimum crew of one but, depending on the main cannons beam settings, could be increased to a crew of four.<ref name="TOREnc" />

==Usage==
Like all forms of long-range weaponry that was not mounted onto vehicles, the LR-16 was operated by dedicated and competitive artillery units, often referred to as ''Cannon wranglers.''<ref name="TOREnc" />

The LR-16 itself saw moderately widespread use, having been employed most prominently on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]].<ref name="TOREnc" /> A pair of very similar, if not identical cannon emplacements were also used at the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]].<ref name="KOTFE Chapter 9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The in-game model of the LR-16 appears again atop the [[Spears of Organa]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] where they are described as "ancient defense turrets" and as such unlikely to be the same weapon.<ref name="Ald Mission">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Raise the Flag|Alderaan}}</ref> Similarly they are seen during the ''Alderaan Civil War'' Warzone where they are again used as defensive [[Turret/Legends|turrets]] employed against [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="Ald Warzone">{{TORcite|type=warzone|Alderaan Civil War}}</ref>
